name: B10-0314/2026 (S&D) – Political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Nicaragua's government to release three political prisoners: Carlos Brenes, his wife Salvadora Martínez Aburto, and Brooklyn Rivera, who died in custody in May 2026. It condemns what it calls systematic repression and crimes against humanity, and asks the European Union to impose stronger sanctions on Nicaraguan officials. It also urges Nicaragua to stop spying on and punishing critics abroad, and to let lawyers, doctors and families reach the detainees. The text is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The text asks for sanctions and releases; nothing changes automatically.
- It concerns Nicaraguan officials, prisoners and exiled critics.
- The Parliament sends its demands to the EU, the UN and Nicaragua.
